description: This file contains unit tests for the 'Strings' utility class in the package 'org.eclipse.hono.util'. It verifies the behavior of the method 'Strings.isNullOrEmpty' with different input cases, including null, empty string, non-empty string, and objects with overridden toString() methods.

classes.name: StringsTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for the utility class Strings, testing various scenarios of string null or emptiness validation.

classes.name: Mock
classes.description: A helper class used within the tests to simulate objects with custom toString() implementations, to test Strings.isNullOrEmpty with non-string objects.

methods.name: testNull
methods.description: Tests that null input returns true for isNullOrEmpty.

methods.name: testEmpty
methods.description: Tests that an empty string input returns true for isNullOrEmpty.

methods.name: testNonEmpty
methods.description: Tests that a non-empty string returns false for isNullOrEmpty.

methods.name: testNonEmptyNonString
methods.description: Tests that an object with a non-empty toString() output returns false.

methods.name: testEmptyNonString
methods.description: Tests that an object with an empty toString() output returns true.

methods.name: testNullNonString
methods.description: Tests that an object with a null toString() output returns true.
